purpose: Determine whether merely raising the spatial derivative order in the pure projectable curvature-carrier family O_n=sqrt(gamma)[D^(n-1) R^(3)]^2 can structurally remove the exact homogeneous hard-hard-soft cubic vertex found nonzero for the frozen n=2 candidate. This is a symbolic conformal-weight theorem; no coefficient or scale is fitted.

operator_family.definition: O_n = sqrt(gamma) times a rotational scalar formed by contracting two copies of D^(n-1) R^(3), with all derivative indices contracted by gamma^ij
operator_family.domain: integer n>=1; flat hard background spatial slice; exact homogeneous conformal mode zeta0 plus finite-k hard modes
operator_family.homogeneous_rescaling: gamma_ij -> exp(2 zeta0) gamma_ij with spatially constant zeta0
operator_family.cubic_to_quadratic_soft_ratio: for one homogeneous soft leg and two hard legs, V3_soft/Q2_cross = 1-2n in the action-density conformal expansion; Fourier symmetrization is checked explicitly for n=2 against K3_s=-96 k^6

outcome_semantics.OBSTRUCTION: For every integer n>=1 in the pure family, 1-2n is nonzero, so increasing n alone cannot make the exact homogeneous soft cubic coupling vanish structurally.
outcome_semantics.ESCAPE: At least one allowed integer n has zero homogeneous conformal weight and therefore removes this coupling without coefficient tuning.
outcome_semantics.INCOMPLETE: The conformal weight or n=2 source-lock cannot be established from the frozen operator definition.

non_claims: not a no-go for linear combinations of independent nonlinear operators
not a no-go for symmetry-protected or additional-field completions
